outcomes.description: Change the DVD from black to white.

nodes.question: Does the DVD identified in the source image remain identifiable in the edited image, and if so, what color is that same DVD?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source DVD in its small rectangular case near the center with the edited image. Complete only if the same DVD is identifiable and white. Partial if that same DVD is identifiable and has changed from black toward white but is not white. Absent if the same DVD is identifiable and remains black with no requested color change. Unknown if its identity or color cannot be established across the images; do not count a separate white disc as the transformed DVD without visual evidence linking it to the source DVD.
nodes.binding: Target: the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image, containing the dark DVD. Track that same DVD across source and edited images using its location and case context; do not bind to an unrelated white disc.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
